steps.acceptance: Anonymous page replay, refused-input clearing, recovery, navigation and immutable artifact readback.
Authenticated host supplies expected artifact identities and current access/source generations; substitute, expiry and revocation controls reject.
Named reviewer/editor accepts scope and conflicts; original exercises and industry mappings reviewed. No invented appointments.
One authenticated scoped harmless approval, current expiry/revocation/replay checks, independent observed effect and reproducible receipt.
Current authenticated save/list/restore/remove, direct readback and restart recovery of permitted synthetic text; no assumption from unit tests.
Frozen candidate, separately held evaluation data, failures and denominators retained; whole-job quality/cost improvement. No promotion from fixture tests.
Consented study, unseen transfer items, blinded rubric and retention measurement, not automated quiz replay.
Existing axis owner admits a scoped measurement under its method; software test counts do not become model scores.
